SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Headquarters, S.S.B.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPALITY
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D.S. 3082
Date December 14th 1932

Subject (in full) The Shanghai Korean weekly news.

Made by D. S. Kim Forwarded by [Signature]

Acting on instructions I made inquiries
regarding the Shanghai korean weekly news and ascertained
that the paper is being edited by Li Yu Pil, President of
the Korean Residents Association. The office of the
Association has been removed to Nantao from no. 13 Avenue
Dubail, French Concession after the raid by the Japanese
Consular authorities on September 9.
The weekly news is printed in the office of the
Association and published by the Korean Nationalist Party
which has no fixed address. Li is reported to be living
in Nantao.
Further inquiries regarding the addresses of
Li and of the Association are being made.

H. S. Kim
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
S.S (D.S. Kim)

page_data.en:
EXTRACT FROM THE SHANGHAI KOREAN NEWS, A KOREAN WEEKLY,
OF DECEMBER 5, 1932.

Korean youths in Shanghai should render valuable
service at this time when the political situation in the
Far East is becoming more critical daily. They should lead
a proper and patriotic life as an example to all other Koreans.

SHANGHAI NEWS

EX-EMPLOYEE CREATES TROUBLE

At 12.30 p.m. December 3 an
ex-employee of the Bus Company named Li Iung Lim, while
under influence of liquor, visited the home of Uk nong sin
and created trouble because Uk had resigned at the time when
all the Korean inspectors discharged from the Bus Co. had
rejoined the Bus Co. Mr. Uk Sung sin, an elder brother of
Uk nong sin, assaulted Li and drove him out of the house.

ARREST AND RELEASE OF KIM CHUL

At 8.30 p.m. November 31 Kim Chul
was arrested by the Japanese Consular Police in French
Concession but was released at 5 p.m. December 1 as the
result of a protest lodged by the French Consul-General.

It is reported that Kim's arrest was
effected through a Chinese spy in the pay of the Japanese
Consular Police . The man's name is Whang Iien Iung. He
is an ex-employee of a certain lawyer and is a member of the
Blood and Soul Corps. He enticed Kim to his home after having
made arrangements with the Japanese Consular Police and Kim
was arrested.

For this reason the French Police and
the Public Safety Bureau are endeavouring to arrest Whang.

PUBLIC TRIAL OF AN CHANG HO

According to information received here
the first public hearing of the case against An Chang Ho, who
was arrested by the Japanese Consular authorities in Shanghai
page_data.zh:
1932年12月5日出版的朝鲜周刊《上海朝鲜新闻》摘录。

在上海的朝鲜青年应当在远东政治局势日益危急的当下提供有价值的服务。他们应当过正当且爱国生活，为所有其他朝鲜人树立榜样。

上海新闻

前雇员制造麻烦

12月3日下午12时30分，巴士公司一名名为 Li Iung Lim 的前雇员，在醉酒状态下拜访了 Uk nong sin 的住所并制造麻烦，原因是 Uk 在所有被巴士公司解雇的朝鲜巡捕重新受雇于巴士公司之时辞职。Uk nong sin 的兄长 Uk Sung sin 殴打了 Li 并将其赶出家门。

金哲（Kim Chul）被捕与释放

11月31日晚8时30分，金哲（Kim Chul）在法租界被日本领事警察逮捕，但因法国总领事提出抗议，于12月1日下午5时被释放。

据报，金氏的被捕是通过一名受雇于日本领事警察的中国间谍实现的。此人名叫 Whang Iien Iung。他是一名某律师的前雇员，也是“血魂团”成员。他在与日本领事警察安排好之后，将金氏诱骗至其家中，随后金氏被捕。

因此，法国警察和公共安全局正努力逮捕 Whang。

安昌浩（An Chang Ho）的公开审判

根据此处收到的消息，因虹口公园投弹案而在上海被日本领事当局逮捕的安昌浩一案的首次公开听证会，将于

page_data.en:
2

following the bomb throwing in Hongkew Park, will take place
in Seoul on December 19.

ARREST OF KIM PIL YUNG AND KIM YUNG IL

Several days ago Kim Pil yung was arrested
by the French Police of the Central Statium for attempting to
steal an over=coat belonging to a certain European. Kim
Yung Il was arrested by the French Police on information given
another
by Kim Pil yung who stated that he had committed the larceny
with Pil yung.

DEPORTATION OF PAK CHUL HWAN

On September 28 Pak Chul Hwan was
arrested in the French Park by a Japanese plain clothes
policeman of the Japanese Consulate. The prisoner was
escorted to Korea on December 1.

MIN PIL HO'S AFFAIR

Some time ago Min Pil Ho, an employee
of the Chinese telegraph office, was arrested by the Japanese
Consular Police. The police tortured him in order to extort
information regarding the whereabouts of Kim Ku . Min was
eventually released to find out Kim Ku's address. Since
his release Min has not been seen since.
page_data.zh:
2

12月19日在首尔举行。

金必勇（Kim Pil Yung）和金永一（Kim Yung Il）被捕

数日前，金必勇（Kim Pil yung）因企图盗窃一名欧洲人的大衣而被中央站（Central Statium）的法国警察逮捕。金永一（Kim Yung Il）则是根据金必勇提供的信息被法国警察逮捕，金必勇称他与必勇共同实施了盗窃。

朴哲焕（Pak Chul Hwan）被驱逐出境

9月28日，朴哲焕（Pak Chul Hwan）在法国公园被日本领事馆的一名便衣日本警察逮捕。该囚犯于12月1日被押送至朝鲜。

闵弼镐（Min Pil Ho）事件

不久前，中国电报局雇员闵弼镐（Min Pil Ho）被日本领事警察逮捕。警方对他施以酷刑，以逼取关于金九（Kim Ku）下落的信息。闵氏最终获释，目的是让他找出金九的地址。自获释以来，再无人见过闵氏。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch No. D. 3087
Date October 1, 1932.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No.
C. S. B. REGISTRY.

Subject (in full) The Shanghai Han Moon Newspaper (上海韓聞), a Korean Revolutionary Publication.
Made by D. Q. Inamura. Forwarded by J. B. K. Q. I.

See
D 140.6

The offices of the Shanghai Han Loon (上海韓聞), the
Shanghai Korean News, the official organ of the Korean National
Party, No. 13 Avenue Dubail, were raided by the Japanese Consular
Police on September 9, 1932, in an attempt to arrest Lee Yu Pil
(李裕弼), President of the local Korean Residents' Association,
on a charge of being connection with the bomb outrage in the
Hongkew Park on April 29, 1932.

It appears that Park Chun San (朴春山) Korean, who
gave out that he was being sought by the Japanese Police, and
who is actually an informer of the Japanese authorities, made an
unsuccessful attempt to trap Lee in the above mentioned office.
The attempt however failed owing to the fact that Lee
left Park's place before the arrival of the Police. In connection
with this case the French Police protested to the Japanese
Consular Authorities regarding the raid being carried without
first notifying them. This, however, was amicably settled by
the Japanese authorities stating that hereafter they would
observe the proper formalities.

Regarding this newspaper which is still being printed
weekly at some unknown address, inquiries show that it came into
existence on January 4, 1932.

The contents of the paper deal chiefly with the
activities of the Korean Revolutionary Party and urge Koreans
to continue to struggle until their independence from Japanese
rule is obtained.

S2,
Please get as many copies as possible of this newspaper and file them.
7:10:32.

J. C. Inamura.
For a copy please J. Inamura
OBR. 7/10 D. C.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 《上海韩闻》（上海韓聞），一份朝鲜革命刊物。
呈报人 D. Q. Inamura。转呈人 J. B. K. Q. I.

参见
D 140.6

1932年9月9日，日本领事警察搜查了位于杜巴伊路（Avenue Dubail）13号的《上海韩闻》（上海韓聞）即《上海朝鲜新闻》（朝鲜国民党机关报）办事处，试图以涉嫌参与1932年4月29日虹口公园炸弹案为由，逮捕当地朝鲜居民会会长李裕弼（李裕弼）。

看来，声称自己被日本警察追捕、实则为日本当局线人的朝鲜人朴春山（朴春山），曾试图在上述办公室设陷阱诱捕李氏。然而，由于李氏在警察到达之前离开了朴氏的住处，该尝试未能成功。在此案相关问题上，法国警察就日本方面未事先通知即进行搜查一事向日本领事当局提出抗议。不过，日本当局表示今后将遵守适当程序，此事得以友好解决。

关于这份仍在某未知地址每周印刷的报纸，调查显示其创刊于1932年1月4日。

该报内容主要涉及朝鲜革命党的活动，并敦促朝鲜人继续斗争，直至获得脱离日本统治的独立。

S2,
请尽可能多地获取该报纸副本并归档。
7:10:32.

J. C. Inamura.
请 J. Inamura 复印一份
OBR. 7/10 D. C.
特别分部主管警官。

SPECIAL INQUIRY
Translation of Extracts from French 1.Report of September 26, 1932

Arrest of two Annamite Communists

At about 5.45 a.m. on September 26 officers of the French Political Branch, together with the International Settlement Police, arrested at the Sing Kang Hotel, 112 Hupeh Road Hong Son and Tran Ngoc Dau alias Blokoff, influential members of the Indo-Chinese Communist Party.

Revelations of a Korean newspaper re Japanese raid of Sept.9 in the French Concession.

According to information recently published in the Shanghai Han Moon newspaper, organ of the Korean National Party, the raid effected by the Japanese Consular Police on September 9 at No.13 Avenue Dubail ( vide our report dated Sept. 10, 1932, p.16, para.26 ), the supposed object of which was the arrest of one Lee Yu Pil ( □□□□ ), President of the local Korean Residents Association, Park Chun San ( 박춘산 ), who let it be understood that he was sought after by the Nippon Police, was actually an informer of the Japanese used to entrap Lee.
The attempt failed owing to the fact that Lee arrived at Park's house, which was the meeting place arranged by the latter, a little too soon. Moreover Lee only remained in the house two or three minutes.
The Shanghai Han Moon believes that Park, fearing reprisals from his compatriots, is now in hiding at the Japanese Consulate.

----------

For inquiry re
Shanghai Han Moon and
report please.

特别调查
1932年9月26日法国警察局报告摘录译文

两名安南共产主义者被捕

9月26日上午5时45分左右，法国政治分部警官会同公共租界警察，在湖北路112号新康酒店（Sing Kang Hotel）逮捕了印度支那共产党有影响力的成员 Hong Son 和 Tran Ngoc Dau（别名 Blokoff）。

朝鲜报纸关于9月9日日本在法租界搜查行动的披露。

根据朝鲜国民党机关报《上海韩闻》最近刊登的消息，日本领事警察于9月9日在杜巴伊路（Avenue Dubail）13号进行的搜查（参见我方1932年9月10日报告，第16页，第26段），其表面目的是逮捕当地朝鲜居民会会长李裕弼（ □□□□ ），但实际上，声称自己被日本警察追捕的朴春山（ 박춘산 ）是日本方面用来诱捕李氏的线人。
由于李氏到达后者安排的会面地点——朴氏住所——的时间稍早，该尝试未能成功。此外，李氏在屋内仅停留了两三分钟。
《上海韩闻》认为，朴氏因害怕同胞报复，目前正躲藏在日本领事馆内。

----------

《上海韩闻》一事进行调查
并报告。

page_data.en:
PLEASING ACTION OF HERO LI BONG CHANG

The Shanghai Korean News, January
11, publishes the following report:-

At 11.30 a.m. January 8, hero Li Bong Chang
attacked the Japanese Emperor in Tokyo like thunder from a
cloudless sky. His heroic action gave the world a big
surprise and caused a great shock to all Japanese making
them tremble at the bravery of Koreans.

The following is a brief history of Li Bong Chang:-

He was born in Seoul, Korea, age 32. His home is very
poor. He was very much interested in military knowledge
in the hope of recovering Korea from Japan. He admires
brave men and hates cowards. Being a member of a poor
family, he visited Tokyo and Osaka where he secured
employment as a daily labourer. Whilst he was leading
a labourer's life his determination to take revenge on the
Japanese became very strong whenever he was humiliated by
Japanese labourers. He waited for a chance to take his
long-cherised revenge. As he could not secure the necessary
weapons he came to Shanghai last winter and called on the
Korean Provisional Government and promised to carry out his
plan. He secured a job in a Japanese shop, the Eishokai Com-
pany in Hongkew, under the assumed name of Z. Kinoshita
(Japanese name) in order to turn away the watchful eyes of
the Japanese Police. In the middle of December he received
two bombs and $600 from the Korean Provisional Government
and immediately proceeded to Tokyo to carry out his plan
on January 8.

A further detailed report on the result of his
action will be published as soon as it is received.
page_data.zh:
英雄李奉昌的壮举

《上海朝鲜新闻》，1月
11日，刊登如下报道：-

1月8日上午11时30分，英雄李奉昌
如晴天霹雳般在东京袭击了日本天皇。他的英勇
举动令世界大为震惊，并使所有日本人受到巨大冲击，
让他们因朝鲜人的勇敢而战栗。

以下是李奉昌的简史：-

他出生于朝鲜首尔，年龄32岁。家境非常
贫寒。他对军事知识非常感兴趣，希望以此从日本手中光复朝鲜。他钦佩勇者，憎恨懦夫。由于出身贫寒，他前往东京和大阪，在那里找到了做日工的工作。在他过着劳工生活期间，每当受到日本劳工的侮辱时，他向日本人复仇的决心就变得非常强烈。他等待机会实施其夙愿已久的复仇计划。由于无法获得必要的武器，他于去年冬天来到上海，拜访了朝鲜临时政府，并承诺执行其计划。为了避开日本警察的监视，他在虹口的一家日本商店“荣商会”（Eishokai Company）谋得一份工作，并使用化名 Z. Kinoshita（日本名字）。12月中旬，他从朝鲜临时政府那里收到两枚炸弹和600美元，随即前往东京，于1月8日执行其计划。

关于其行动结果的更详细报告将在收到后立即发布。

He was born in Seoul, Korea, age 32. His home is very 
poore He was very much interested in military kmowledge 
in the hope of recovering Korea from Japan. He admires 
brave men and hates cowards. Being a member of a poor
